title: Model European conditional four-byte lookup
changes: Add an authenticated typed model for the conditional European 74-row lookup while retaining original wrapping address arithmetic outside the projection.
validation: One isolated Windows build and one Wine filter pass source bytes, JSON and shape guards, original two-field and byte-reader prefixes for inside and outside indices, and the row77 metadata producer.
limitations: The model is not yet published or consumed by the runtime. Ordinary use, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open; no performance measurement.
